title: Bentwaters guards see multicolor disc retracting a rod
summary: Robert Hastings tells of Bentwaters guards see multicolor disc retracting a rod, about December 1980 at RAF Bentwaters, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: couple of guys on the record saying that there was an object that was a multicolor disc quite near them quite large

plain: Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFOs around nuclear bases, talks about events in December 1980 at Bentwaters, a Royal Air Force base in England. He says a couple of guards have gone on the record about a large, multicolored disc that came quite near them and pulled a rod back into itself. For Hastings, it fits a pattern of such objects watching nuclear bases.
